title: Wazuh manager configuration (/etc/wazuh-manager/wazuh-manager.conf)
description: Single source of truth for the manager configuration: types, ranges, defaults and documentation of every option. Consumed by the manager_config C++ module (embedded) and by the Python framework (installed copy).

duration.description: Seconds as an integer, or a string with a unit suffix: s, m, h, d, w (w_parse_time grammar). At most 999999999 seconds: a string has at most 9 digits in seconds, 7 in minutes, 5 in hours, 4 in days, 3 in weeks, leading zeros aside, so that no reader overflows.

duration_nonzero.description: A duration (same grammar and limits as duration) that must be at least 1 second: zero, in any unit, is rejected.

duration_no_weeks.description: Seconds as an integer, or a string with a unit suffix: s, m, h, d (no weeks). At most 999999999 seconds: a string has at most 9 digits in seconds, 7 in minutes, 5 in hours, 4 in days, leading zeros aside, so that no reader overflows.

duration_no_weeks_nonzero.description: A duration (same grammar and limits as duration_no_weeks) that must be at least 1 second: zero, in any unit, is rejected.

size.description: Bytes as an integer, or a string with a unit suffix: B, K, M, G (w_parse_size grammar, case-insensitive). At least 1 byte, so zero is rejected in any unit; at most 15 digits in bytes, 12 in K, 9 in M, 6 in G (leading zeros aside), so that no reader overflows.

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to the manager home.

ip.description: One IPv4 address in dotted-quad form (optionally prefixed with ::ffff:) or one IPv6 address in full or compressed form, with no CIDR prefix or netmask.

host.description: A host name (letters, digits, '-' and '_' in dot-separated labels of at most 63 characters) or an IP address (the ip definition).

url.description: An http:// or https:// URL naming a host: a host name or IPv4 address, or an IPv6 address in brackets, then an optional :port and path.

tls13_ciphers.description: Colon-separated TLS 1.3 cipher suites, each one of TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256 (the suites remoted and authd accept).

global.description: Options shared by remoted and the task manager's disconnection sweep.

agents_disconnection_time.description: Time without keep-alives after which an agent is marked disconnected (minimum 1 second; 0 is rejected).

logging.description: Where and how the manager daemons write their own log: plain (logs/wazuh-manager.log) and/or json (logs/wazuh-manager.json).

log_format.description: Formats of the manager log: plain (logs/wazuh-manager.log), json (logs/wazuh-manager.json) or both.

legacy.description: Classic TCP/UDP agent listener. Absent block = disabled; present block = enabled unless 'enabled: false'.

ca_delivery.description: Send the manager's CA certificate to a pre-v5.0.0 agent over the WPK transfer channel during a remote upgrade, so the upgraded agent has a trust anchor. Disable when a corporate PKI or a configuration-management tool distributes the anchor instead.

local_ip.description: Bind address: one IPv4 or IPv6 address, without a CIDR prefix, netmask or host name. Absent: 0.0.0.0, or every IPv6 interface (::) when ipv6 is enabled; remoted applies that default, not the schema.

queue_size.description: Event queue size (events). Values above 262144 are accepted with a warning. wazuh-manager-remoted allocates the whole queue when it starts, one pointer (8 bytes on a 64-bit host) per event slot, before any event arrives, plus the memory of every event waiting in it: 2147483648 asks for 16 GiB at once. No check compares the value with the memory of the host, so a size it cannot allocate passes wazuh-manager-control check and stops remoted at start.

rids_closing_time.description: Idle time before a RIDS counter file is closed (minimum 1 second; 0 is rejected).

connection_overtake_time.description: Seconds before an agent may take over an existing connection.

https.description: HTTPS agent listener served by remoted_module.

bind_addr.description: Bind address: one IPv4 or IPv6 address, without a CIDR prefix, netmask or host name.

global_prefix.description: Path prefix of every HTTPS route, at most 255 characters. Must start with '/', may only contain A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ - and '/', no empty, '.' or '..' segments.

certificate.description: Server certificate (PEM), at most 511 characters. Absolute path directly inside /etc/wazuh-manager/certs: the credential check of wazuh-manager-control start refuses any other location, a relative path included.

key.description: Server private key (PEM), at most 511 characters. Must be set together with 'certificate'. Absolute path directly inside /etc/wazuh-manager/certs: the credential check of wazuh-manager-control start refuses any other location, a relative path included.

ca.description: CA bundle used to verify agent certificates, at most 511 characters. Empty = client certificate verification disabled, unless 'verification_mode' is set explicitly, in which case /etc/wazuh-manager/certs/root-ca.pem is used.

ca_certificate.description: CA certificate that signs the listener certificate, at most 511 characters; served on GET /cacerts and pinned by enrollment tokens. Not the client-verification CA ('ca'). Absolute path directly inside /etc/wazuh-manager/certs: the credential check of wazuh-manager-control start refuses any other location, a relative path included.

verification_mode.description: Agent certificate verification. Absent: 'certificate' when 'ca' is set, 'none' otherwise.

ciphers.description: TLS 1.3 cipher suites the HTTPS listener negotiates, at most 255 characters.

max_body_size.description: Maximum HTTP request body the transport accepts; a larger request is dropped without a response. Keep it above remoted.auth_max_body_size (internal option, 5 MiB by default).

dual_stack.description: Accept IPv4 clients on an IPv6 bind address (clears IPV6_V6ONLY). Only applies when bind_addr is an IPv6 address; 'no' keeps the socket IPv6-only.

enroll_rate_limit.description: Sustained POST /enroll requests per second this manager forwards to authd, counted for the node as a whole and not per agent. 0 disables the limit. Applied after the credential check, so a request that fails it never spends it (a verified enrollment also after its body checks), and kept as two buckets of this rate: one for enrollments whose password or enrollment token (with uses left) was verified, one for re-enrollments, enrollments without a credential and enrollment tokens with no uses left. Requests over it get 429 without reaching authd. Short bursts are absorbed: each bucket may serve twice this value back to back before the rate paces it.

cacerts_rate_limit.description: Sustained GET /cacerts requests per second this manager serves, counted for the endpoint as a whole and not per agent. 0 disables the limit. Requests over it get 429. Short bursts are absorbed: the endpoint may serve twice this value back to back before the rate paces it.

agents.description: Agent version policy of the connection handlers.

allow_higher_versions.description: Accept agents whose version is higher than the manager's.

auth.description: wazuh-manager-authd enrollment service (also read by remoted for HTTPS enrollment).

port.description: Enrollment listening port. Bound only while legacy enrollment is active (authd enabled, remote_enrollment and legacy_enrollment, which follows remote.legacy.enabled when unset); only then does it count against the other listener ports.

use_source_ip.description: Register the agent with its source IP instead of 'any'.

force.description: Re-enrollment policy for agents that already exist.

key_mismatch.description: Force when the agent key does not match.

disconnected_time.description: Force when the existing agent has been disconnected longer than 'value'.

enabled.description: Whether the disconnection time is checked before forcing the re-enrollment.

value.description: Minimum time the existing agent must have been disconnected.

after_registration_time.description: Do not force within this time after the previous registration.

purge.description: Purge removed agents from the key store.

ciphers.description: TLS 1.3 cipher suites accepted for enrollment.

ssl_agent_ca.description: CA used to verify agent certificates during enrollment. Empty = disabled.

ssl_verify_host.description: Verify the agent certificate host name.

ssl_manager_cert.description: Manager certificate (PEM). The file must exist even when auth.disabled is true: the validation with file checks that runs before every start checks it whatever authd does. While authd is enabled it must also be an absolute path directly inside /etc/wazuh-manager/certs: the credential check of wazuh-manager-control start refuses any other location, a relative path included.

ssl_manager_key.description: Manager private key (PEM). The file must exist even when auth.disabled is true: the validation with file checks that runs before every start checks it whatever authd does. While authd is enabled it must also be an absolute path directly inside /etc/wazuh-manager/certs: the credential check of wazuh-manager-control start refuses any other location, a relative path included.

remote_enrollment.description: Accept enrollment through the HTTPS listener.

legacy_enrollment.description: Accept enrollment through the legacy TLS port (1515), used only by 4.x agents. No default of its own: when absent it follows remote.legacy.enabled, so a configuration without the remote.legacy block has no legacy enrollment either. An explicit value always wins.

agents.description: Agent version policy of the enrollment service.

allow_higher_versions.description: Enroll agents whose version is higher than the manager's.

backup.description: Periodic backups of the wazuh-db databases (backup/db/).

global.description: Periodic backup of the global database.

enabled.description: Whether the global database is backed up periodically.

interval.description: Time between backups (minimum 1 second; 0 is rejected).

enabled.description: Whether the vulnerability scanner module runs.

feed-update-interval.description: Time between CTI feed updates (minimum 1 second; 0 is rejected).

pageSize.description: Indexer page size used by the scanner.

indexer.description: Wazuh indexer connection shared by modulesd, the engine and the cluster. Mandatory: wazuh-manager-analysisd cannot start without at least one host.

hosts.description: Indexer URLs: http:// or https://, then a host name, an IPv4 address or an IPv6 address in brackets, then an optional :port and path (https://indexer:9200).

ssl.description: TLS material of the indexer connection. Every path must be absolute and directly inside /etc/wazuh-manager/certs: the credential check of wazuh-manager-control start refuses any other location, a relative path included.

certificate.description: Client certificate (PEM). Empty = no client certificate.

task-manager.description: Task manager module. Also serves remote agent upgrades.

task_ttl.description: Seconds a pending agent task may wait, from its creation, before it is expired. Manager tasks never expire. 0 = the module default (3600). At most 2147483647: wazuh-manager-conf validate accepts a larger value, but wazuh-manager-modulesd -t refuses it, so wazuh-manager-control check and the start do; a running modulesd logs an error and keeps the default.

cleanup_interval.description: Seconds between cleanup passes. 0 = the module default (300). At most 2147483647: wazuh-manager-conf validate accepts a larger value, but wazuh-manager-modulesd -t refuses it, so wazuh-manager-control check and the start do; a running modulesd logs an error and keeps the default.

max_payload_bytes.description: Maximum task payload. 0 = the module default (1048576). At most 2147483647: wazuh-manager-conf validate accepts a larger value, but wazuh-manager-modulesd -t refuses it, so wazuh-manager-control check and the start do; a running modulesd logs an error and keeps the default.

max_tasks_per_poll.description: Tasks handed out per poll. 0 = the module default (100). At most 2147483647: wazuh-manager-conf validate accepts a larger value, but wazuh-manager-modulesd -t refuses it, so wazuh-manager-control check and the start do; a running modulesd logs an error and keeps the default.

upgrade_enabled.description: Whether the manager serves remote agent upgrades (WPK upgrades requested through the API).

wpk_repository.description: WPK repository (host/path). A value with an http:// or https:// scheme is kept as given; without one, https:// (or http:// when the upgrade asks for it) is prepended. No default: left unset, the repository is picked from the target agent version.

cluster.description: Cluster identity and transport (wazuh-manager-clusterd; name/node_name/node_type also read by the C daemons and the engine). Mandatory: every manager is a cluster node, and cluster.key has no usable default.

name.description: Cluster name. Use only letters, digits, _ and -: the worker handshake separates its fields with spaces, so a name with a space passes every check and no worker ever joins.

node_name.description: This node's name. Use only letters, digits, _ and -: the master refuses a worker whose name has any other character (error 3060), and no check refuses such a name beforehand.

node_type.description: Role of this node in the cluster.

key.description: 32-character shared key; the installer generates a random one.

bind_addr.description: Address the master listens on for worker connections: a host name (at most 253 characters) or an IP address. Ignored on workers.

hidden.description: Hide this node in cluster listings. Currently read by no component: setting it has no effect.
